text: Program Description Courses Chinese phonetics, grammar, vocabulary, and Chinese rhetoric, ancient Chinese, ancient Chinese, humanistic geography, history, Chinese modern history of China, Chinese ancient history Note: Beginners can be directly placed into undergraduate classes to study. However, they can be registered as 2nd year students only if they obtain the HSK Band 3-5 certificates. And they can be registered as 3rd year students only if they obtain the HSK Band 6 certificates. Miscellaneous fees RMB 1350/semester
